# VixTube - Adult Video Embedding & Streaming Directory

> VixTube is a free HD adult video indexing platform serving streaming clips, amateur adult content, and organized video categories.

## Core Navigation Map

- [Home Page](https://vixtube.net/): Main index featuring latest trending videos.
- [Popular Videos](https://vixtube.net/popular): Most viewed adult video clips sorted by lifetime metrics.
- [Featured Content](https://vixtube.net/featured): Top rated clips selected by user engagement.
- [Sitemap](https://vixtube.net/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap listing all published video watch pages.

## API & Data Endpoints

- [Search Map](https://vixtube.net/search-maps.json): JSON mapping of category and tag slugs.
- [Videos Feed](https://vixtube.net/videos.json): JSON feed of video metadata and embed parameters.

## Compliance & Legal

- [DMCA Policy](https://vixtube.net/dmca): DMCA Takedown and Copyright guidelines.
- [Terms of Service](https://vixtube.net/terms): Age verification (18+) and service terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://vixtube.net/privacy): Data handling and cookies notice.
- [Contact Support](https://vixtube.net/contact): Inquiries and legal support contact.
